notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Death's Presece triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
